files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: Set every negative credit_balance to 0 and add a column in_debt that is True for the riders whose balance was negative and False otherwise (including riders with an empty balance). `result` should be a table with the columns rider_id, credit_balance and in_debt.
intended_computation: Read riders.csv; in_debt = credit_balance < 0 (False for an empty balance); set negative balances to 0, empty balances stay empty; return rider_id, credit_balance, in_debt for every rider.

acceptable_variants.notes: id columns (rider_id, station codes) may be written as integers without leading zeros; in_debt may be 0/1

notes: invited_ids_author labelled by hand after the intents were frozen (step A2); intent not rewritten for it.
